item.content:encoded: In contrast to Doctor North, I thought this did a good job of 'effectively' saying the minimum. It's short and punchy without trying to use too purple language. There's a clear separation from scene to scene and a uniting theme throughout. And in the end, I am lead to a set of ideas that the author has passed to me to think about as I leave the work. +1 on my end.
